card.name: Digits inside gene variant codes
card.fires_on: A digit in the middle of a mutation or variant code, such as a position number in a resistance mutation (I47V) or a DNA change (m.1555A>G). It also fires on a metabolite code letter.

modes.label: Protease mutation numbers
modes.description: A digit inside an amino-acid substitution such as T74P or I47V in a resistance mutation list.

modes.label: Nucleotide change positions
modes.description: A digit inside a gene position code such as m.1555A>G or -1639G>A.

modes.label: Codon numbers
modes.description: A digit in a codon number within a mutation description.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a number in a gene mutation name, like I47V or m.1555A>G.
